subject.title: gateway install/status hardcodes ~/Library/LaunchAgents — prevents boot-without-login on macOS

question: What first-class macOS LaunchDaemon contract, if any, should OpenClaw support for gateway install/status and the related lifecycle commands?
rationale: The fix chooses a privileged launchd boundary involving root-owned plist mutation, sudo/operator UX, non-root execution user, durable service environment, and coexistence with user LaunchAgents, so automation should not choose the policy alone.

options.title: Explicit audited system scope
options.body: Keep user LaunchAgent as default and add owner-reviewed LaunchDaemon install/status/lifecycle/doctor/docs/tests with clear sudo and `UserName` behavior.

options.title: Diagnostic guidance only
options.body: Do not manage LaunchDaemons yet; improve status/doctor/docs so operators using custom system daemons get accurate detection and safe manual commands.

options.title: Defer system daemon support
options.body: Leave this open as product backlog until maintainers sponsor the larger privileged-service surface.

recommendation.title: Explicit audited system scope
recommendation.body: Keep user LaunchAgent as default and add owner-reviewed LaunchDaemon install/status/lifecycle/doctor/docs/tests with clear sudo and `UserName` behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest gateway lifecycle feature-history signal and has already appeared in the related maintainer discussion as the likely launchd scope decision owner.
